magi merlin.bio: Montréal singer-songwriter Magi Merlin makes alternative R&B shaped by soul, hip-hop and experimental pop, pairing sharp writing with a gritty, groove-heavy sound.

majid jordan.bio: Toronto R&B duo Majid Jordan, formed by singer Majid Al-Maskati and producer Jordan Ullman, blends atmospheric R&B with electronic production and emotionally direct songwriting.

manu militari.bio: Québec rapper and songwriter Manu Militari is a major voice in francophone Canadian hip-hop, known for detailed narrative writing, social observation and an independent career dating to the early 2000s.

marie davidson.bio: Montréal producer and musician Marie Davidson makes electronic music that moves through minimal wave, techno, Italo disco and spoken-word performance with a dark, sharply observational edge.

maylee todd.bio: Toronto multidisciplinary artist Maylee Todd is a singer, songwriter, producer and performance artist whose music ranges across soul, R&B, indie pop, electronic and experimental forms.

measha brueggergosman-lee.bio: Fredericton-born Canadian soprano Measha Brueggergosman-Lee is an internationally acclaimed opera and concert singer whose recordings and performances also span jazz, gospel and contemporary repertoire.

melanie durrant.bio: Toronto singer-songwriter Melanie Durrant makes soulful R&B and alternative hip-hop soul, pairing formal vocal training with an eclectic sound and a long-running independent Canadian career.

melanie fiona.bio: Toronto-born singer-songwriter Melanie Fiona is a Grammy-winning R&B and soul vocalist known for emotionally direct songwriting, powerful vocals and a catalogue that bridges classic soul with contemporary production.

michie mee.bio: Toronto rapper and actor Michie Mee is a pioneering Canadian hip-hop artist known for combining rap with reggae and dancehall and for becoming the first Canadian rapper signed to a major U.S. record deal.

moka only.bio: British Columbia rapper and producer Moka Only is one of Canada's most prolific independent hip-hop artists, known for a vast solo catalogue and his early role in forming Swollen Members.

muzion.bio: Montréal trio Muzion, formed by Dramatik, Imposs and J-Kyll, is a foundational Haitian-Canadian hip-hop group whose multilingual, socially engaged work helped shape Québec rap.

narcy.bio: Montréal-based Iraqi-Canadian rapper, writer, professor and multidisciplinary artist Narcy, born Yassin Alsalman, is a pioneering voice in Arab hip-hop whose work spans music, film, education and cultural production.

nate husser.bio: Montréal rapper Nate Husser, born Nathaniel Huskinson, first emerged with The Posterz before developing a solo catalogue that moves between melodic rap, alternative hip-hop and bilingual collaborations.

nicholas craven.bio: Gatineau-born, Montréal-based producer Nicholas Craven is known for soulful, gritty sample-chop production and an extensive catalogue with leading voices in contemporary underground hip-hop.

ouri.bio: French Guianan-born, Montréal-based musician Ouri is a classically trained producer, DJ and multi-instrumentalist whose work blends electronic music, orchestral composition, pop and R&B.
